NVIDIA Optical Flow SDK 5.0.7 interface headers (nvOpticalFlowCommon.h,
nvOpticalFlowD3D11.h), copied unchanged. Each header carries its own MIT
licence notice ("This copyright notice applies to this header file only"),
which must be kept. Nothing else from the SDK (samples, libraries, docs) is
included; the engine itself (nvofapi64.dll) ships with the NVIDIA driver and
is loaded at run time. VP is not sponsored or endorsed by NVIDIA.
